raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (ingested 2026-01-18, transactions dated 2026-01-17) has amount_unit='USD_CENTS' on all 377 rows, and its amounts are whole-number cent values (e.g. 1651.0 = $16.51), but the silver step casts amount without converting units. This inflates 2026-01-17 totals and the mean, while the median stays near the true ~41. Dividing USD_CENTS amounts by 100 in silver_transactions corrects the data, and the gold tables rebuild from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(CASE WHEN amount_unit = 'USD_CENTS' THEN amount / 100.0 ELSE amount END AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
